results.title: SIT completes probe into Ram Temple donation theft case, submits final report to trust
results.description: In the Ram Temple Donation row, the Uttar Pradesh Home Department has submitted the Special Investigation Team's (SIT) final report, along with necessary action plans, to the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple Teerth Kshetra Trust. The three-member SIT headed by Lucknow Divisional Commissioner Vijay Vishwas Pant, included IG Range Kiran S. and Special Secretary (Finance) Neel Ratan Kumar made several strong recommendations in its preliminary report submitted on June 23.
